trial_descriptions.is_good_trial: From the raw MAT key file (isGoodTrial in getKeys.m). True = this trial has matching 2P imaging coverage (use this filter for cross-modal analyses). False = no imaging frames overlap the stim window (trial may still have valid ephys + behavior data). Defaults to True if no MAT key was available.
trial_descriptions.is_hit: True if the mouse correctly turned the wheel; False otherwise (miss)
trial_descriptions.response_time: Time from trial start to wheel response (s); NaN if miss
trial_descriptions.start_time: Start time of epoch, in seconds
trial_descriptions.stim_channel: Ripple stimulation channel; 0 if catch trial
trial_descriptions.stop_time: Stop time of epoch, in seconds
